result: AI agents claim today's spotlight, with five major stories outpacing quantum computing's four. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a production milestone as adoption triples, signaling mainstream readiness. Model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration inside startups, while tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models. Multi-agent swarms are graduating from demos to regulated enterprise workflows, and observability standards are finally emerging to trace agent decisions end to end. Together, these headlines paint a rapidly maturing ecosystem where autonomous agents are moving from experimentation into mission-critical infrastructure.
